title: Add S3+KMS backup module for Redwood Private (bucket, key, least-privilege IAM) + examples
author: Bruno Silva
description: Context: Private Day-2 backup/restore requires a supported, repeatable storage + encryption + IAM pattern for VPC deployments. This PR adds a Terraform module that provisions an S3 bucket configured for encrypted backup artifacts (SSE-KMS), a dedicated KMS key (optionally using an existing key), and a least-privilege IAM policy intended for the backup/restore job/installer identity. The module is designed to be "drop-in" for enterprise VPC environments with restricted IAM, and to align with the backup artifact layout produced by `redwood-private-installer backup create` (manifest + encrypted blob). What’s included: (1) module `modules/private_backup_s3_kms/` with S3 bucket, bucket policy options, versioning/lifecycle hooks, and KMS key + alias; (2) IAM policy document for backup writers/readers scoped to the bucket and a configurable prefix (default `redwood-private/backups/`), including required KMS permissions; (3) example usage under `examples/private-backup-s3-kms/` showing how to wire the policy to an IAM role (IRSA-friendly) and how to pass the bucket/prefix into Helm values; (4) README docs: assumptions, required inputs, hardening guidance, and common misconfigurations seen in customer accounts. Security posture: bucket has public access block enabled; encryption at rest enforced via default SSE-KMS and (optionally) a deny on `s3:PutObject` without `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption`; KMS key policy supports granting to a dedicated backup role and supports rotation; recommended conditions included (kms:ViaService for S3, encryption context notes). Out of scope: cross-region replication, multi-account backup centralization, and server access logs destination bucket (doc note added). Testing: `terraform fmt`, `terraform validate`, and tflint; example plan runs in CI with mocked variables (no AWS calls).
changed_areas: modules/private_backup_s3_kms/* (new module: bucket, kms, iam policy docs, outputs)
commits: terraform: scaffold private_backup_s3_kms module with bucket + kms + iam policy
docs: add example usage and wire outputs to helm values snippet

ci: add example validate job for private-backup-s3-kms
notable_snippets: IAM policy scope: s3:ListBucket is limited to the bucket and conditioned on the configured prefix; object actions (GetObject/PutObject/DeleteObject) are limited to arn:aws:s3:::${bucket}/${prefix}*.

KMS permissions: kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey* limited to the module key ARN; optional condition added for kms:ViaService = s3.${region}.amazonaws.com when using the module-managed key.
Optional bucket policy hardening: deny PutObject when x-amz-server-side-encryption != aws:kms (configurable with var `enforce_sse_kms = true`).
